lead_independence.headline: Florida lawmaker pushes for mandatory dog breeder registry after Martin County hoarding case
lead_independence.lead: State Rep. Meg Weinberger said the Palm City rescue has made strengthening Florida's animal protection laws more urgent. She wants to build on recent legislation signed by Gov. Ron DeSantis that requires the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation to publish voluntary best practices for dog breeders. These are little steps, baby steps, but if you really want to be a great breeder, then you're going to want to have that stamp of Florida, Weinberger told WPTV.
